blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Public cervical cytology benchmarks release many cell crops cut from far fewer microscope fields or slides and are often split at the crop level, so test cells share acquisition parents with training cells. In a preregistered study, crop-level splitting raised SIPaKMeD accuracy by 0.97 percentage points across twelve architectures and twenty seeds (95% CI 0.59-1.39), and CRIC accuracy by 12.08 points (11.16-12.99). On SIPaKMeD, a factorial that fixes training crop and parent counts attributes the gain to sibling exposure (1.73 points, 0.95-2.51), not to the extra parent diversity of crop-level splits (0.00). Parent identity is decodable at about 100 times chance, yet erasing 82% of its above-floor linear recoverability left the gap unchanged, and Grad-CAM did not distinguish leaking from clean models; matching test cells' color statistics to an unseen same-class field removed most of the advantage. Decodability and saliency cannot substitute for a parent-disjoint split.
blocks.zh: 公共宫颈细胞学基准释放出许多从远为较少的显微镜场或滑动中切除的细胞作物,并且经常在作物层面被分化,因此测试细胞与训练细胞共享获得父母. 在一项预先登记的研究中,作物一级的分块将SIPAKMED的精度提高了0.97个百分点,涉及12个建筑和20个种子(95% CI 0.59-1.39),审评委的精度提高了12.08个百分点(11.16-12.99)。 在SIPAKMED上,一个修补训练作物和母体计数的因子将收益归结于兄弟接触(1.73分,0.95-2.51分),而不是归结于作物一级分数的额外母体多样性(0. 父母身份的解码率大约是100倍,但消除了82%的上层线性可恢复性,使差距保持不变,Grad-CAM没有区分从清洁模型中漏出;将测试细胞的颜色统计与未见的同级域匹配,消除了大部分优势. 解码性和显著性不能取代父母离异的分裂.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Public cervical cytology benchmarks are mostly released as cell crops cut from far fewer microscope fields or slide images [ 17 , 15 , 20 ] . Sibling crops share their field’s stain, illumination, focus and background, and sometimes pixels. A crop-level split, the default for files that look like independent images, puts siblings on both sides of the split (Fig. 1 a).
blocks.zh: 公共宫颈细胞学基准大多随着细胞作物从远为更少的显微镜场或滑动图像切除而释放出来 [17, 15, 20]. 兄弟姐妹作物分享其田地的污渍,照明,焦点和背景,有时甚至像素. 裁剪级别拆分,对看起来像独立图像的文件的默认,将兄弟姐妹置于拆分的两侧(图1 a).

blocks.en: Figure 1: Study design. (a) A crop-level split (P1) places siblings from one acquisition parent in training and test; a parent-disjoint split (P2) does not. (b) Matched-size factorial: one test set per seed; leak and clean training sets have identical crop and field counts and differ only in the test fields’ siblings, while diversity varies separately. (c) Diagnostics asking whether decodable parent identity is what the leak uses.
blocks.zh: 图1:研究设计。 (a) 作物一级拆分(P1)使来自一个购置方的兄弟姐妹参加培训和测试;父母-离子拆分(P2)不设。 (b) 匹配大小的因子:每个种子一个测试集;泄漏和清洁培训集的作物和田间计数相同,只在试验场的兄弟姐妹中有所不同,而多样性则不同。 (c) 诊断者询问可解码的父身份是否是泄漏用途。

blocks.en: That sibling crops inflate scores is expected: placing tiles of one subject in training and validation inflated digital pathology scores by up to 41% [ 4 ] , and non-independent splits and shortcut cues mislead medical image evaluation more broadly [ 12 , 7 , 24 ] . Benchmark artifacts have been audited in chest radiographs [ 11 ] , shortcut mechanisms dissected in segmentation [ 14 ] , and image-level splitting shown to inflate CT accuracy [ 16 ] . Contamination does not imply consequence, however: in brain-tumor MRI, removing heavily contaminated test images, without retraining, left balanced accuracy essentially unchanged [ 23 ] . We ask the complementary question of when acquisition siblings do change the score, which requires retraining under each protocol rather than filtering the test set.
blocks.zh: 预计这些兄弟作物会飞升的分数是:将一个科目的瓦片放在培训和验证中,夸大数字病理学分数高达41%[4],非独立的分裂和捷径提示会更广义地误导医学图像评价[12,7,24]. 对基准文物进行了胸腔放射图[11],捷径机理分解[14],图像层分解显示提高CT精度[16]. 然而,污染并不意味着后果:在脑肿瘤核磁共振中,在不进行再培训的情况下,去除严重污染的试验图像时,平衡的准确性基本上保持不变[23]。 我们提出一个补充问题,即获得的兄弟姐妹何时会改变得分,这需要根据每项协议进行再培训,而不是过滤测试集。

blocks.en: Three questions follow. How much does crop-level splitting change public cytology benchmarks? Is the change leakage? A grouped split removes the test parents’ siblings but, at a fixed crop budget, also leaves fewer distinct training parents (crop-level training sets hold 18% more on SIPaKMeD), so a lower score could reflect lost diversity, a confound that split comparisons leave in place. Can common diagnostics certify an evaluation? Decodable source identity is increasingly read as a sign of shortcut use [ 8 ] , and saliency maps as evidence of where a model looks. A preregistered study and a registered follow-up (2,281 trained models) contribute: • Structure: closed forms that predict a split’s exposure from its crop-to-parent table (Sec. 2 ). • Consequence: one simulation-powered test per benchmark across twelve architectures (Sec. 4.1 ). • Causal isolation: a SIPaKMeD factorial that varies sibling exposure at fixed crop and parent counts (Sec. 4.2 ). • Diagnostic caution: interventions showing that the linearly decodable parent code and saliency do not track the leak (Sec. 4.3 ).
blocks.zh: 后三问. 作物一级的分化在多大程度上改变了公共细胞学基准? 变化渗漏了吗? 组合式的拆分可以消除测试父母的兄弟姐妹,但是,在固定的作物预算中,也留下较少的区别性培训父母(作物一级的培训集在SIPAKMED上多持18 % ) , 因此较低的分数可以反映多样性的丧失,而这种分裂性比较就留了下来。 常见的诊断能够证明评价吗? 可解码源身份越来越多地被解读为使用[8]的捷径标志,而显赫的地图作为模型外观的证据. 一项预先登记的研究和一项已登记的后续行动(2 281个训练有素的模型)有助于: 结构:预测从作物到父母表(第2节)中分化暴露的封闭式表格。 后果:在12个架构中每个基准进行一次模拟动力测试(第4.1节) 原因隔离:一种在固定作物和母体计数时不同兄弟接触的SIPAKMED因子(第4.2节) 诊断性谨慎:干预表明线性可解码的父体代码和显性不跟踪泄漏(第4.3节)。

blocks.en: Structure: closed forms that predict a split’s exposure from its crop-to-parent table (Sec. 2 ).
blocks.zh: 结构:可预测分裂物从作物到父母表暴露的封闭形式(第2款)。

blocks.en: Consequence: one simulation-powered test per benchmark across twelve architectures (Sec. 4.1 ).
blocks.zh: 顺序:在12个架构中每个基准进行一次模拟动力测试(第4.1节)。

blocks.en: Causal isolation: a SIPaKMeD factorial that varies sibling exposure at fixed crop and parent counts (Sec. 4.2 ).
blocks.zh: 因果关系隔离:一种SIPAKMED因子,在固定作物和父母计数时,其兄弟接触量各不相同(第4.2条)。

blocks.en: Diagnostic caution: interventions showing that the linearly decodable parent code and saliency do not track the leak (Sec. 4.3 ).
blocks.zh: 诊断性谨慎:干预措施表明线性可解码的父代码和显著性没有跟踪泄漏(第4.3条)。

blocks.zh: 2 数据和获取等级

blocks.en: 3 Study design
blocks.zh: 3 研究设计

blocks.en: Everything reported comes from the preregistered Study 2 and its registered follow-up; an earlier pilot (Study 1, six architectures, five seeds) served only the power analysis. Each phase was registered before its own runs: Study 2’s splits, caches, design tables and analysis scripts were hashed and committed before its first model was trained, with smoke tests on crop-level splits only, and the follow-up after the Study 2 analysis but before any follow-up model or analysis.
blocks.zh: 所报道的一切都来自预先注册的"研究2"及其已注册的续作;一个较早的飞行员("研究1","6个建筑","5个种子")只服务于动力分析. 每一个阶段在自行运行前都登记了: 研究2的拆分、缓存、设计表和分析脚本在培训其第一个模型之前被散开并投入使用,只进行作物一级拆分的烟雾测试,在研究2分析之后、但在任何后续模型或分析之前采取后续行动。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Consequence and causal isolation. (a, b) Crop- minus parent-level accuracy per architecture (mean and 95% t t interval over seeds) and the registered pooled estimates (diamonds). (c) The SIPaKMeD factorial: accuracy on the common test set for leak and clean training sets at two diversity levels (bold: mean of four architectures; faint: each architecture), with the registered leakage and diversity estimates.
blocks.zh: 图 2:后果和因果隔离. (a,b) 作物-减去每个结构的家长级精确度(平均和95%吨的种子间隔)和登记的集合估计数(钻石)。 (c) SIPAKMED因子:在两个多样性层面(粗体:四个结构的平均值;昏倒:每个结构)的漏损和清洁培训集的共同测试集的准确性,并附有记录的漏损和多样性估计。

blocks.en: Protocols and training. P1 is a stratified crop-level 80:20 split, P2 a parent-disjoint split of equal test size, and P3 additionally merges parents linked by near-duplicates. Twelve ImageNet-pretrained backbones (ResNet-18/50, DenseNet-121, MobileNet-V2, EfficientNet-B0/V2-S, RegNetY-1.6GF, ConvNeXt-T, Swin-T, MaxViT-T, ViT-B/16, DINOv2 ViT-S/14) are fine-tuned with one deterministic recipe (AdamW, 10 − 4 10^{-4} , batch 64, 20 epochs, resized-crop and flip augmentation) and scored at the final epoch without model selection; per-crop logits and weights are kept.
blocks.zh: 协议和培训。 P1是分层的作物级80:20拆分,P2是等效测试大小的亲-离子拆分,P3额外将亲子通过近重复连接. 12个ImageNet前置骨干(ResNet-18/50、DenseNet-121、MobileNet-V2、高效率) Net-B0/V2-S,RegNetY-1.6GF,ConvNext-T,Swin-T,MaxViT-T,Vit-B/16,DINov2 VIT-S/14)对定型配方进行了微调(AdamW,10–4 10^{-4},批次64,20个纪元,大小调整和翻转增量),并在最终时段未进行模型选择而得分;每个作物的对数和重量保持不变.

blocks.en: One test per benchmark (H1, H2). Instead of one test per architecture, the protocol effect is tested once, acc ∼ x + ( 1 + x ∣ arch ) + ( 1 ∣ seed ) + ( 1 ∣ split ) , \mathrm{acc}\sim x+(1+x\mid\mathrm{arch})+(1\mid\mathrm{seed})+(1\mid\mathrm{split}), (1) where x = ± 1 2 x=\pm\frac{1}{2} codes P1 vs. P2 and split , shared by all architectures within a seed, stops twelve evaluations of one test set from counting as twelve [ 2 , 13 ] . A registered residual check selected a two-way cluster bootstrap as the primary inference, with Satterthwaite, Kenward–Roger, binomial-mixed-model and sign-flip tests as sensitivity analyses. Twelve architectures and twenty seeds gave a simulated power of 0.977 for a 0.8-pp effect on SIPaKMeD; CRIC uses six architectures and ten seeds.
blocks.zh: 每个基准(H1、H2)进行一次测试。 协议效果不是每个架构一次测试,而是测试一次,acc × + (1 + × × + + + 拱) + (1 + + 种子) + (1 + + + + + 分裂),\ mathrm{ acc} x + (1 + mid\ mathrm{ arch}) + (1\ mid\ mathrm{ split}), (1) x = ± 1 2 x=\pm\ frac{ 1}{2} 代码 P1 vs. P2 并拆分 , 由种子内的所有建筑共享 , 停止对一个测试集进行十二次评价 计数为 12 [2, 13]. 登记在册的剩余检查选择了双向集束靴作为主要推论,Satterthwaite,Kenward–Roger,二元混合模型和标志纤维测试作为敏感性分析. 12个建筑和20个种子在SIPAKMED上提供了0.977的模拟功率,0.8-pp效果;审评委使用6个建筑和10个种子。

blocks.en: Leakage vs. diversity (H3). The factorial (Fig. 1 b) fixes one test set per seed, half the crops of a random 30% of multi-crop SIPaKMeD fields (about 527 crops), and varies only the training set, always 220 crops per class. Clean cells draw from other fields; leak cells swap the last fields of the same permutation for the test fields’ remaining siblings. Within a diversity level, leak and clean cells thus share crop count, field count and allocation; 720 vs. 504 fields gives a 1.43-fold diversity contrast that brackets the natural 1.18. H3 is the leak effect in a mixed model (four architectures, ten seeds, 160 runs); diversity is estimated within clean cells.
blocks.zh: 泄漏与多样性(H3). 要素(图1b)每种子固定一套试验,即30%的多作物SIPAKMED田地(约527种作物)一半的作物,并且只不同训练,总有每班220种作物。 清洁细胞从其他字段抽取; 漏泄细胞将最后一个相同形状的字段交换给试验场剩下的兄弟姐妹。 因此,在多样性水平上,漏泄和清洁细胞分享作物计数、田间计数和分配;720对504个田地具有1.43倍的多样性对比,将天然的1.18加起来。 H3是混合模型中的漏泄效应(四个架构,十个种子,160跑);多样性在清洁细胞内估计.

blocks.en: Diagnostics. Study 2 registered background transplants (H4) and a gradient-reversal parent adversary (H5) [ 6 ] . The follow-up tests eight hypotheses (F1–F8, 940 new models; Fig. 1 c). The H3 models are re-scored after background removal, illumination flattening, greyscale, low-pass filtering, or Reinhard transfer [ 19 ] of each cell’s color statistics to an unseen field of its own class (F2; the target is chosen by label, so this is a controlled diagnostic); the factorial is retrained with masked backgrounds (F3) or strong HED color jitter [ 22 ] (F4). Parent recoverability R R , the within-class accuracy of a logistic field probe on frozen features, is lowered by rank-limited LEACE erasure with a refitted head [ 3 ] (F5), stain normalisation (F6) and a probe-matched linear adversary (F7), each required to remove a quarter of the above-floor R R while costing at most 1 pp of P2 accuracy; F8 pools the dose–response, and F1 tests a slide-level label prior in CRIC. Grad-CAM [ 21 ] attribution outside the cell mask is compared descriptively, with a randomised-head check [ 1 ] . H1 stands alone; H2–H5 and F1–F8 are separate Holm families [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 诊断 研究2 注册背景移植(H4)和梯度-逆向母体对抗(H5)[6]. 后续测试了八个假设(F1-F8,940新模型;图1 c). H3型号在背景清除,照明平整,灰度,低通道滤波,或Reinhard将每个单元格的颜色统计[19]转录到自己类的隐形字段(F2;目标通过标签选择,所以这是一个可控的诊断);因子被蒙面背景(F3)或强烈的HED色彩焦距[22](F4)重新训练. 对冷冻特性进行后勤场探针的级内精确度R, 由有等级限制的LEACE 擦除头部[3][(F5)、污物正常化(F6)和一个探针匹配的线性对手(F7)降低,每个R都要去除上层R的四分之一,而费用最高为P2精确度的1pp;F8将剂量-反应和F1测试在审评委之前的滑动级标签。 Grad-CAM [21] 细胞口罩外的归属被作描述性比较,与随机头检查[1]. H1单独存在;H2–H5和F1–F8是独立的霍尔姆家族[9].

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: All 1,341 study runs and 1,580 follow-up tasks completed, none diverged, and every result matched its registered split hash. Table 2 lists all registered tests.
blocks.zh: 所有1 341项研究以及1 580项后续任务都已完成,没有一项任务有差异,每一项结果都与其登记的散列相匹配。 表2列出了所有登记测试。

blocks.en: 4.1 Crop-level splitting inflates both benchmarks
blocks.zh: 4.1 作物一级的分化夸大了两个基准

blocks.en: On SIPaKMeD, accuracy was 97.14% under P1 and 96.18% under P2 (H1 = = 0.97 pp, 0.59–1.39), with all four sensitivity analyses at p p < < 0.001. Every architecture scored higher under P1, by 0.66–1.44 pp (Fig. 2 a): crop-level splitting hides a quarter of the errors. Merging near-duplicate-linked parents changed nothing (P2 − - P3: 0.03 pp, −0.49 to 0.56), so shared parents, not stray duplicates, carry the effect, and the architecture ranking was largely preserved (Kendall τ = 0.82 \tau=0.82 ). On CRIC, with about 29 mixed-class cells per slide, accuracy fell from 90.48% to 78.40% (H2 = = 12.08 pp; 11.6–12.8 pp per architecture; Fig. 2 b) and balanced accuracy from 78.53% to 58.89%; a size-matched crop-level control gave the same gap (12.11 pp). That control fixes training size, not slide composition, and the factorial below was run on SIPaKMeD only, so the CRIC gap is consistent with acquisition leakage but not causally decomposed. Our CRIC inputs are 100 × 100 100\times 100 windows around the published nucleus coordinates, so absolute accuracies are not comparable with other CRIC results.
blocks.zh: 在SIPAKMED中,P1的精度为97.14%,P2的精度为96.18%(H1 = = 0.97页,0.59-1.39),所有四种灵敏度分析均在p < 0.001。 每个建筑在P1下得分较高,分数为0.66–1.44pp(图2 a):作物级的分割隐藏四分之一的错误. 将近似重复的双亲合并起来,没有改变什么(P2−-P3:0.03页,−0.49页至0.56页),所以共享双亲,而不是偏差的重复,带有效果,建筑排名基本保留下来(Kendall\\=0.82\tau=0.82). 在审评委上,每张幻灯片大约有29个混合级单元格,准确率从90.48%下降到78.40%(H2==12.08页;每张架构11.6-12.8页;图2b),均衡准确率从78.53%下降到58.89%;大小匹配的作物水平控制也存在同样的差距(12.11页)。 这种控制可以固定培训的大小,而不是幻灯片的构成,下面的因子仅运行在SIPAKMED上,因此审评委的缺口与获取渗漏一致,而不是因果分解。 我们的审评委投入是100×100 100\时100窗口,围绕已公布的核心坐标,因此绝对精确度与审评委的其他结果无法相比。

blocks.en: 4.2 On SIPaKMeD, the inflation is leakage, not diversity
blocks.zh: 4.2 在SIPAKMED中,通货膨胀是渗漏,而不是多样性。

blocks.en: At fixed crop count, field count and allocation, adding the test fields’ siblings raised accuracy on the common test set by 1.73 pp (0.95–2.51) in every architecture at both diversity levels, while 43% more fields without leakage did nothing (0.00 pp, −0.65 to 0.64; interaction −0.20 pp, p = 0.60 p=0.60 ; Fig. 2 c). The leak replicated on fresh seeds (1.47 pp) and persisted with every background masked in training and testing (F3: 1.86 pp). In an exploratory split it was as large on test crops sharing no pixel with any training crop (1.68 pp) as on overlapping ones (1.78 pp): what helps is a seen field, not memorised pixels.
blocks.zh: 在固定的作物计数、田间计数和分配中,加上试验场的兄弟姐妹提高了每种结构在多样性水平上1.73页(0.95-2.51)所设定的共同试验的准确性,43%的田间没有渗漏(0.00页,0.65至0.64;相互作用-0.20页,p=0.60p=0.60;图2 c)。 漏水在新鲜种子上复制(1.47页),并在训练和测试中以每个背景掩盖下去(F3:1.86页)。 在探索性分裂中,试验作物与任何训练作物没有像素(1.68页)与重叠作物(1.78页)一样大: 帮助的是一个可见的场,而不是记忆中的像素.

blocks.en: Table 2: All registered tests, in pp (H5, F7, F8: pp per pp of R R ; F1: pp of probability; F6: pp per unit strength), signed so that each hypothesis predicts a positive value. p p : H1 bootstrap, others Holm. † Significant in the opposite direction.
blocks.zh: 表2:所有注册测试,在pp(H5,F7,F8:pp per pp of R R;F1:pp of position;F6:pp per unit strong)中签名,以便每个假设预测一个正值. p: H1 靴子,其他 Holm. + 向相反方向重要。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Diagnostics. (a) Each arrow takes one architecture from no manipulation to the strongest in-regime LEACE erasure or linear adversary: recoverability falls, the gap does not. (b) Leak minus clean accuracy under test-time interventions (color transfer targets an unseen field of the cell’s own class) and training-time color jitter. (c) Grad-CAM attribution outside the cell mask for leak and clean models of the same seed and diversity level; the diagonal marks equality.
blocks.zh: 图3:诊断。 (a) 每个箭头需要一种结构,从不操纵到最强的LEACE 消除或线性对手:可恢复性下降,缺口没有。 (b) 在试验时间干预(颜色转移针对牢房自己班级一个看不见的场景)和训练时间色彩紧张的情况下,漏减干净精度。 (c) 细胞罩外的梯度-CAM归属,用于同一种子和多样性水平的泄漏和清洁模型;对角标记平等。

blocks.en: 4.3 Linear decodability and saliency do not track the leak
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 线性可解码性和显著性不跟踪泄漏

blocks.en: Neither registered Study 2 mechanism test located the leaked signal: background transplants (H4) and gradient reversal (H5), which ConvNeXt-T evaded by making parents more decodable ( R R 29.5% to 55.1%), were not supported. Reducing the linearly decodable parent code did not move the gap either (Fig. 3 a). Rank-256 LEACE cut R R from 25.1% to 5.4%, removing 82% of its above-floor value (class-only floor 1.2%), in all twelve architectures at a 0.17-pp cost in P2 accuracy, and the gap stayed at 0.93–0.95 pp (F5); the linear adversary passed its check in all three architectures with no change (F7); pooled over 15 cells the slope was 0.000 (−0.005 to 0.005; F8), so a 20-pp loss of R R moves the gap by at most 0.1 pp. Grad-CAM put 21.8% of attribution outside the cell in leak and clean models alike (difference −0.09 pp, −0.57 to 0.39; Fig. 3 c), although its maps passed the randomised-head check (median Spearman ρ = 0.08 \rho=0.08 ). On CRIC, seen slides pulled minority-class cells away from the slide majority (F1: −4.29 pp), which argues against a simple slide-majority prior.
blocks.zh: 注册的研究2机制测试都没有找到漏出的信号:背景移植(H4)和梯度逆转(H5),ConvNEXt-T通过使父母更加可解码(R R29.5%至55.1%)而逃避,但没有得到支持. 缩小线性可解码的父代码也没有移动空隙(图3 a). 排名256 LEACE将R从25.1%削减至5.4%,取消了所有十二个建筑的上层价值的82%(只有一层的1.2%),P2精度为0.17-pp成本,差距维持在0.93-0.95pp(F5);线性对手在所有三个建筑中都通过了检查,没有变化(F7;集合15个电池,坡度为0.000(−0.005至0.005;F8),因此R的20-pp损失最多以0.1页移动差距。 Grad-CAM将21.8%的归属置于细胞外,清洁模型也是如此(Difference-0.09pp,−0.57至0.39;图3c),尽管其地图通过了随机头检查(中间Spearman $0.08\rho=0.08)。 在审评委上,看到的幻灯片将少数阶层的细胞从多数幻灯片中拉开(F1:−4.29页),后者反对以前简单的多数幻灯片。

blocks.en: Only color transfer moved the leak. Matching each test cell’s color statistics to an unseen field of its own class cut the leak from 1.72 to 0.46 pp (F2: 1.27 pp, 0.38–2.16), whereas flattening illumination (1.30 pp) or removing the background (1.17 pp), at comparable accuracy cost, did not (Fig. 3 b); strong HED jitter in training left it intact (1.71 vs. 1.47 pp; F4). Because the transfer is label-conditioned and shifts the test distribution, it implicates field-specific appearance without identifying what the networks learned.
blocks.zh: 只有颜色转移移动了泄漏。 将每个试验室的颜色统计与自己班级的隐形字段相匹配,将漏水从1.72页减少到0.46页(F2:1.27页,0.38-2.16页),而平整照明(1.30页)或去除背景(1.17页),以可比的精度成本,则没有(图3b);在训练中强烈的HED紧张使其完好无损(1.71对1.47页;F4)。 由于转移带有标签条件,并会改变测试分布,因此它隐含着特定字段的外观,而没有识别网络学到了什么.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and conclusion
blocks.zh: 5. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: Crop-level splitting inflates both public cervical cytology benchmarks we trained on. On SIPaKMeD the inflation is leakage: it appears when a test cell’s acquisition siblings are in training, not when training merely gains parent diversity. On CRIC, with 29 mixed-class cells per slide instead of four single-class crops per field, the gap is twelve times larger; without a factorial there, it is consistent with, not attributed to, sibling leakage. A benchmark’s exposure can be computed from the closed forms of Sec. 2 before any model is trained. Rankings largely survived on SIPaKMeD, but accuracies under crop- and parent-level splits are not comparable: on CRIC the protocol gap exceeds the spread between architectures.
blocks.zh: 作物一级的分化会夸大我们所训练的公共宫颈细胞学基准。 在SIPAKMED中,通货膨胀是渗漏的:当一个测试室的收购兄弟姐妹正在接受培训时,而不是当培训只是获得父母的多样性时。 就审评委而言,每个幻灯片有29个混合级单元格,而不是每个田间有4个单一级作物,差距是12倍大;没有系数,它与兄弟间渗漏一致,而不是归因于兄弟间渗漏。 在训练任何模型之前,可从封闭式第2条中计算出基准暴露。 排名基本上在SIPAKMED上幸存下来,但作物和父母级划分下的速率并不可比:在审评委上,协议差距超过了结构之间的宽度。

blocks.en: The mechanism is narrowed, not identified. The advantage survives background masking, does not depend on shared pixels, does not follow a simple slide-majority prior and is unaffected by reducing the linear parent code, while label-conditioned color transfer implicates field-specific appearance; nonlinear or spatially encoded parent information may still carry it. The methodological lesson holds regardless: models whose measured parent code was largely erased, and whose saliency matched that of clean models, still benefited from leakage. Probes establish availability, not use [ 5 , 18 ] , and neither probes, saliency nor augmentation can stand in for a grouped split.
blocks.zh: 该机制缩小,没有确定。 该优势在背景遮掩后幸存下来,不依赖于共享像素,不遵循简单的幻灯片多数前,并且不会因为减少线性父代码而受到影响,而标签有条件的颜色传输则涉及特定字段的外观;非线性或空间编码的父信息仍然可能携带. 方法上的教训不问:其衡量的母代码在很大程度上被抹去,其显著性与清洁模型相匹配的模型仍然得益于渗漏。 探测器可以确定可用性,不使用[5、18],探测器、显要物或增强物都不能构成组合分裂。

blocks.en: Limitations. Parents are the deepest released units, not patients: parent-disjoint evaluation removes the leakage measured here, but patient-level grouping could reveal further dependence that these experiments cannot bound. The factorial trains on 1,100 crops rather than 3,239, establishing the leak’s existence and direction more firmly than an exact decomposition of H1. One training recipe was used, erasure acts on linearly readable pooled features, and the follow-up, registered after the Study 2 results, is confirmatory only for its own questions.
blocks.zh: 限制。 父母是释放最深的单位,而不是病人:父母-离子评价可以消除这里测量的渗漏,但病人级分组可以揭示出这些实验无法束缚的进一步依赖性. 1,100个作物上的因子列车而非3,239个,比H1的精确分解更牢固地确定了泄漏的存在和方向. 使用了一种培训配方,消除了线性可读集合特征上的动作,在研究2结果之后登记的后续行动只针对其本身的问题加以确认。

blocks.en: Recommendations. Releases should label every observation with its parent, and its patient where permitted; evaluations should split at the deepest released unit, publish hashed fold manifests and report the fraction of test observations with a training sibling. Code, provenance maps, split manifests, run records and a risk calculator are at https://github.com/optimisticexquisite/cytofair .
blocks.zh: 建议。 释放应将其每一项观察与母体和允许的病人贴上标签;评价应在最深处的释放单位分开,公布散列折叠清单,并以训练兄弟报告试验观察的一小部分。 在https://github.com/opimisticexquisite/cytofair网站上,有代码、出处地图、分期清单、运行记录和一个风险计算器。

blocks.en: 6 Compliance with ethical standards
blocks.zh: 6 遵守道德标准

blocks.en: This research was conducted retrospectively using de-identified human cytology images made available in open access by the creators of SIPaKMeD, Cx22, CRIC and Herlev. No new data were collected, and ethical approval was not required for this secondary analysis of public data.
blocks.zh: 这项研究是追溯性地利用由SIPAKMED、Cx22、审评委和Herlev的创造者公开获取的脱身份人类细胞学图像进行的。 没有收集新的数据,对公共数据进行第二次分析不需要道德批准。
